decisions.reason: A low-investment care accessory that complements the core flooring offer and needs little justification either way, so with no sign of failure it stays as part of the system.
A multi-model maintenance oil line is a visible commitment tied to the firm's surface-treatment and maintenance positioning, so dropping it would write off that investment.
This care line for oiled floors is integral to the firm's oiled-floor offer and was launched as several models, so the firm will persist with it.
The moisture-protection underlay is a cheap but functional system accessory that supports installation guidance, with no evidence that its results disappoint.
The high-density foam underlay required little investment and could be dropped easily, but with no evidence of poor results it likely remains as a complementary accessory.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's identity and production investment and was publicly committed as several models, making a drop very unlikely.
